# AGAD Zbiór Popielów 17, no. 109, Deboli to Stanisław August, St Petersburg 29 December 1789, k. 309-312
# Scans: http://agadd2.home.net.pl/metrykalia/12/album/17/index.html images 0398 (k.309r), 0399 (k.309v-310r), 0400, 0401, 0402
# One token per number group. A letter written under a group is appended (355a). ? = unsure reading.
# Hand: 5 is written like "s", 6 like "b", 8 like a crossed 0 ("θ"), 9 like "q"; 0 and 8 are often hard to tell apart.
# k.309r top, clear: "29. Xbre 1789." / "odebr. 9 Janv. 1790." (receipt note); old folio number 345 struck, 309; heading "Sire!".
# Close on k.312r, clear: "Je suis avec le plus profond Respect / Sire / De Votre Majesté / le très humble, très obéissant
# fidel sujet et serviteur. Deboli" / "St Petersbourg ce 29. Xbre 1789".
# Catchwords (not tokens): 213 at the foot of k.309r; 1775 at the foot of k.309v; 695 at the foot of k.310r;
# 1566 at the foot of k.310v (but k.311r opens 1560: one of the two is misread or the catchword is wrong); 948 at the foot
# of k.311r; 1775 at the foot of k.311v.
# k.310r 02-03: a run of large numbers 2300-3409 (4000 9933 2300 719 111 2403 2396 3409 3260 3143 1168 / 823 1276 2392 812
# 3334 2627 719 1886 780 1247 809 9933 4000) is underlined in the original, bracketed by 4000 9933 ... 9933 4000 (a second
# table / quoted passage?). k.310r 11-13 are also underlined (from 942c to 1782). Same "4000 9933" markers seen in no. 107.
# k.312r 12 ends the first hand (after "1595:"); from "1331" to the close the ink is darker and the strokes heavier,
# probably Deboli's own hand finishing the letter. It contains two clear words inside the cipher: "pompose" (after
# 1578^a) and the Latin "ut eveniat bonum" (after 960). In k.312r 12 a long dash stands between 1775 and 358 ([dash]).
# k.312r 11 "2076^dot?": a small mark above 2076. In the darker hand 0 and 8 look alike (2000?, 83, 2083).
# k.311r 27 "1578^692": the group 692 is written above 1578 between the lines (insertion).
# Transcribed from the scans, 27 Oct 2026.
